name: Scarlet & Violet Event Special Pack Vol. 6

description.text: The sixth Scarlet & Violet event special pack (朱&紫 活动特别包 第六弹), handed out in mainland China from 6 November 2026, when Black Bolt and White Flare came out. Players got it at events of the official Pokémon card gyms, each gym handing it out its own way while stocks lasted, or by post as a reward for weekly and monthly missions in the Pokémon Card Member mini program, redeemable from 9 November 2026 to 31 January 2027. Each pack held one card of 80: 30 non-holo cards and Pokémon ex holos (89% of packs), 25 Poké Ball pattern holos (10%) and 25 Master Ball pattern holos (1%).
